provenance.note: 2026-08-10-1's stored shot, which printed a spin (5991) and a spin axis (+2.5), with no handedness: no golfer attributed. No loft, as the vector carries none, since a printed spin needs no branch chosen. The shot rows are that vector's recorded launch_monitor:hd_golf rows with Python's values: handedness reaches no shot row. The flight is Rust's. A printed axis with no handedness is not read ('+ = fade' is a right-handed reading, analysis::flight_infer::infer_spin_axis), so the ball is flown with no axis, and the values of flight_carry_yds (122.411), flight_apex_yds (18.5532), flight_descent_angle_deg (36.9185) and flight_time_s (4.5175) are Rust's, under the vector's row text; the vector's right-handed flight, flown on the axis, recorded 122.3567, 18.5396, 36.9178 and 4.515. flight_landing_offline_yds is refused as no_handedness in Rust's sentence, which no other committed vector reaches: the one unattributed engine vector carries no shot.
provenance.source: worked by hand in M35 P4, the M35 plan's P4 list; each shot is the named corpus vector's input.shot, edited only as the note says, and Rust's answer (golf_core::run_shot) was checked equal to this expected within RTOL before the file was committed
